entities.summary: Nick Holden is a Canadian former professional ice hockey player who was a defenceman for 12 seasons in the National Hockey League (NHL) for the Columbus Blue Jackets, Colorado Avalanche, New York Rangers, Boston Bruins, Vegas Golden Knights, and Ottawa Senators.
